readme.text:
Hybrid: a dark hero band carries the drop (live countdown to 9:00 AM ET + the hero deal); calm editorial cards below build trust.

Brand: D/M monogram + DAILYDEALS wordmark, black and white. Logos are placeholder PNGs cut from your files until the SVGs arrive.

Type: Bodoni Moda (display, matches the monogram) + DM Sans (UI).

Tweak "accent" on either board: red, gold or mono.

The category filter works. Deals, prices and stores are layout samples.
